dedupe_keys.name: ceads input output table collection china provincial and city level mrio tables and india uk and russia mrio datasets

description: CEADs publishes a collection of multi-regional input-output tables for emerging economies, used to trace how production in one region depends on inputs from others. The China tables for 2012, 2015 and 2017 cover 31 provinces and 42 socioeconomic sectors, built with entropy theory and a gravity model, and newer China tables for 2018 and 2020 are listed alongside two older 2012 versions. The page also offers city-level China MRIO tables for 2012, 2015 and 2017, a nested table for the Jing-Jin-Ji urban agglomeration, an inter-city table for Greater China distinguishing firm ownership, an India table for 32 states from 2011 to 2019 and a 2015 India table, a UK dataset for 2017 to 2022 and a Russia table for 2016 with 85 constituent entities and 59 sectors. The CEADs consortium of Chinese and international researchers produces them. Format and access: downloadable tables for academic users from the CEADs data page. Licence: not stated beyond academic use; free. Caveats: tables are estimated from national and provincial statistics with entropy or location-quotient methods, not surveyed flows. They support network flow and resilience models of disaster ripple effects through interregional supply chains. Related catalogue records are the China multi-regional input-output table 2012 and CEADs emission accounts for 40 emerging economies, and the adaptive MRIO study of China's 2021 rainstorms.
